text: The family lets their dog sleep on the sofa. Their pet rests beside them every evening.
Each night, the household allows its canine companion to relax on the couch next to them.
A veterinarian examines a kitten and discusses vaccinations and balanced food with its owner.
Daily walks and reward-based training help a young puppy learn commands and stay active.
A python rests inside a warm enclosure. Its caretaker checks the reptile’s water and temperature.

The bank approved a loan so the family could buy a house. Monthly payments include interest.
A lender accepted the household’s mortgage application. They will repay the borrowed money over many years.
A savings account pays interest on deposits. Customers compare fees before choosing a bank.
Investors buy shares in companies and accept the risk that market prices may fall.
A customer uses a mobile banking application to transfer money and check account balances.
The bank updated its software to detect fraudulent payments and protect customer accounts.
A developer writes a Python script to automate repetitive tasks and process text files.
A programmer uses code to handle routine work automatically and read documents from disk.
A software team fixes a bug by inspecting an error message and testing the corrected code.

Cloud servers host a website. Engineers monitor memory usage and deploy application updates.
An online tutorial explains functions, loops, and variables to people learning computer programming.
Children sat on the river bank and watched fish swimming through the clear water.
Young visitors rested beside a stream and observed aquatic animals moving beneath the surface.
Volunteers remove plastic from the river to protect water quality and wildlife habitats.
A python swims through a wetland. The snake hunts near the water and shelters in vegetation.
Dark clouds bring heavy rain. Rising river water spreads across the surrounding fields.
Trees growing along the river bank reduce erosion and provide shade for fish.
